item.title: Scientists Find Surprising Double Benefit of Exercise for Parkinson's
item.description: A seven-year study found that people with Parkinson's disease who were more physically active experienced slower declines in memory, thinking, and movement.

item.title: Breakthrough PTSD Treatment Achieves 68% Remission Rate in Clinical Trial
item.description: A newly FDA-cleared PTSD treatment uses personalized brain mapping and magnetic stimulation to target abnormal brain activity, with a clinical trial showing high remission.

item.title: One of Earth's most powerful supervolcanoes is refilling with fresh magma
item.description: Deep beneath Japan's Kikai caldera, a massive magma reservoir is refilling 7,300 years after one of Earth's most powerful volcanic eruptions.
